name: Taxonomy
description: Adds a taxonomy class extending AbstractTaxonomy from rtcamp/wp-framework. One class per taxonomy; the consumer's Taxonomies module instantiates it via the Loader.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the taxonomy class. Default 'Inc\Taxonomies' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-namespace to override.
Directory for the taxonomy file. Default 'includes/Taxonomies'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Taxonomies'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Taxonomies'.
i18n text domain. Usually matches the plugin slug.
Taxonomy slug, lowercase, kebab- or snake-case, e.g. 'product-category'.
PascalCase class name, derived from slug.
Post type slug this taxonomy attaches to. For multiple, comma-separate (e.g. 'product,page').

wiring.description: Add the new taxonomy class to the Taxonomies module's get_classes() array. The framework's Loader will instantiate it and call register_hooks() on init. If the Taxonomies module does not exist yet, scaffold it first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=Taxonomies --kind=taxonomy`.
